summary: Keep structured internal native content out of transcript prose instead of rendering its legacy text fallback.

schema.detail: Uses existing timeline block visibility; no wire or storage changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Content whose non-source presentation blocks are all internal or hidden-by-harness remains an inspectable UnknownEvent hidden by default. Schema-permitted mixed visible/internal non-source bodies remain visible as a collapsed Message with internal records disclosure, with raw body inspection only on expansion; no production producer of such mixed bodies has been demonstrated. Internal source-record annotations do not hide visible prose. Visible JSON messages, unspecified visibility and legacy entries without blocks retain their existing presentation.
